Марганец.about: Manganese is an essential trace element, but the SR on minerals for sports explicitly states: no relevant work on manganese was found.
Марганец.caution: ESPEN notes the potential toxicity of micronutrients in excess; There is no data on safe doses of manganese in the pool.
Марганец.food_sources: Cereals, nuts and tea; Separate data on the sources of manganese are not provided in the abstracts of the pool.
Марганец.guidelines: ESPEN 2022 makes recommendations for micronutrients based on consensus: there are few intervention studies, and a meta-analysis could not be performed.
Марганец.how_to_choose: Manganese supplementation is not supported by any human work in the pool; if a deficiency is suspected, analysis rather than independent use.
mechs: Minerals and trace elements are involved in hundreds of biological processes, and manganese belongs to this class
Correction of deficiency with nutritional support
Micronutrient deficiency is considered as a possible factor in the pathogenesis of androgenic alopecia
No relevant works on manganese were found in SR on sports minerals
The effect of the additive has not been studied
Марганец.myths: “All athletes need manganese” - no studies on manganese were found in SR for 128 works. “Improves hair growth” - in the SR on alopecia, manganese is only in the list, it is not in the conclusions.
Марганец.name: Manganese
Марганец.onset: Not studied: There is no RCT with manganese in the pool.
Марганец.title: Manganese
Марганец.who_needs: Only with confirmed deficiency or with nutritional support. Manganese deficiency was not identified in either the athletic performance data or the vegan diet data.
